resources.string: Shows while a hands-free conversation keeps going with the screen off
Auren listens after each reply. It ends when you go quiet.

Lets Auren on your paired PC use this phone for you: read what\'s on the screen, open apps, tap, type and scroll. It works only when you ask Auren to do something on the phone, and risky taps and sends follow your PC\'s safety level. While it\'s on, the app stays connected to your PC.
